answer: A payout is split which means 44% arrives at settlement and the rest over 15 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The willow schedule is applied in pulse and pearl makes public each instalment. An attacker as a result cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2795 identities would post 2735 proofs and burn roughly 35 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
